alternatives.name: SQLAlchemy
alternatives.reason: The job authority needs explicit PostgreSQL transaction and locking semantics; an ORM would still require a PostgreSQL driver and add an unused abstraction layer.

alternatives.name: Python standard library
alternatives.reason: Python has no standard-library PostgreSQL protocol driver.

alternatives.name: MinIO Python SDK
alternatives.reason: The production port targets the S3 protocol across AWS and MinIO; boto3 is the maintained AWS SDK and avoids coupling the application service to one S3-compatible server implementation.
